name: MCP Collateral Ligament Injury of the Finger
tags: mcp collateral ligament injury of the finger
definition: Sprain or rupture of a finger metacarpophalangeal collateral ligament after lateral stress or trauma.

investigations.principle: Radiographs exclude avulsion fracture; ultrasound/MRI is selective for high-grade tears.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Complete unstable tears require hand-surgery review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Sprain or rupture of a finger metacarpophalangeal collateral ligament after lateral stress or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
